series_label: Proportion of population using basic drinking water services
source_or_custodian: United Nations (United Nations Statistics Division, SDG Global Database; provenance undata/p/SDG)
status_or_notes: National total for Nigeria (country/NGA). The server's label reads 'basic drinking water services' (SDG series SP_ACS_BSRVH2O); the response does not say it is 'at least basic'. The server returned no 2025 value: its coverage is 2000-2024, 25 observations, annual (P1Y). Other national series with similar names exist only by urban/rural breakdown. Among them is a UNICEF 'At least basic' series, which covers rural areas only.
